summary: Elva provides controls for Atlas Direct, Atlas Remit's NUSD payout service, targeted for launch on 1 February 2027, hosted on AWS in Singapore.
deliverables: Tenant on Amazon Web Services, Singapore region
Case management workspace with case audit history
Name and sanctions screening, up to 30,000 a day
Payout ledger connector, up to 30,000 payouts a day
NUSD wallet screening per Annex 1; 30 days of hypercare after go-live
